# Flower
**专为安卓移动端打造的 Minecraft Java 版性能优化整合包**

## 核心定位
Flower 是一款针对安卓端 Java 版 Minecraft 开发的轻量化优化整合包，适配 PojavLauncher 等主流安卓 Java 版启动器，基于 Minecraft 1.20.1 等版本，同时支持 Forge 与 Fabric 双加载器。
本包专注解决安卓设备运行 Java 版 Minecraft 时的帧率低、内存占用高、卡顿闪退等核心痛点，在保留原版完整特性的前提下，最大限度提升移动端的游玩体验。

## 核心特性
- **全场景性能优化**：集成多款经过移动端兼容性验证的优化模组，覆盖渲染逻辑、内存管理、区块加载、实体运算等路优化，显著提升平均帧率，降低场景切换与区块加载时的卡顿概率
- **极致轻量化设计**：仅保留核心优化相关内容，无冗余模组与附加功能，安装包体积小，对设备存储空间与运行内存占用低，适配中低端安卓机型
- **双加载器完整支持**：同时提供 Forge 与 Fabric 双版本，满足不同玩家的使用习惯与模组兼容需求，整合包已预设好最优优化配置，安装后即可直接使用，无需额外手动调试
![before（100fps）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4208b5b14e6707665057014c19aba1632f516bf7.jpeg)![after（200fps）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb0068221aec104e05e8b0a1294e6b6248692ab9.jpeg)
## 适配说明
- 支持 Minecraft Java 版 1.20.1 等版本
- 兼容 Forge 与 Fabric 双加载器
- 适配绝大多数安卓系统移动设备，兼容 PojavLauncher 等主流安卓 Java 版启动器

## 重要提示
**需要明确：移动端受限于硬件性能与运行环境，无论如何优化，都难以达到电脑端的运行水准。不同配置的设备，最终优化效果会存在差异，请以实际使用情况为准。**

## 开发与反馈
本整合包目前仍处于早期开发阶段，我们会持续优化适配效果与兼容性。
如果你有更好的优化方案、适配建议，或是在使用中遇到闪退、不兼容等问题，欢迎通过以下渠道私信作者反馈：
- B站主页：https://space.bilibili.com/1860367670?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0
- QQ：1848851257

# Flower
**Performance-Optimized Modpack for Android Minecraft: Java Edition**

## Core Overview
Flower is a lightweight performance-optimized modpack built exclusively for Android devices running Minecraft: Java Edition, compatible with mainstream Android Java launchers like PojavLauncher. Based on Minecraft 1.20.1 and more, it supports both Forge and Fabric mod loaders.
This modpack focuses on solving core pain points when running Java Edition on mobile, such as low framerate, high memory usage, and stuttering, crashes. It maximizes the mobile gaming experience while retaining the full features of the vanilla game.

## Core Features
- **Full-Scene Performance Optimization**: Integrates multiple optimization mods verified for mobile compatibility, covering full-link optimization including rendering logic, memory management, chunk loading, and entity calculation. It significantly improves average framerate and reduces stuttering during scene switching and chunk loading.
- **Ultra-Lightweight Design**: Only retains core optimization-related content, no redundant mods or additional functions. It has a small installation package size, low occupation of device storage and RAM, and is compatible with low-to-mid range Android devices.
- **Dual Loader Support**: Provides both Forge and Fabric versions to meet the usage habits and mod compatibility needs of different players. The modpack comes with pre-configured optimal optimization settings, ready to use right after installation, no additional manual debugging required.
![before（100fps）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4208b5b14e6707665057014c19aba1632f516bf7.jpeg)![after（200fps）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb0068221aec104e05e8b0a1294e6b6248692ab9.jpeg)
## Compatibility
- Supports Minecraft: Java Edition 1.20.1 and more
- Compatible with both Forge and Fabric mod loaders
- Works with most Android mobile devices, and mainstream Android Java Edition launchers including PojavLauncher

## Important Notice
**Please note: Limited by the hardware performance and operating environment of mobile devices, no matter how much optimization is done, it is difficult to reach the performance level of the PC version. There will be differences in the final optimization effect on devices with different configurations, please refer to the actual usage experience.**

## Development & Feedback
This modpack is still in early development, and we are continuously optimizing the adaptation effect and compatibility.
If you have better optimization solutions, adaptation suggestions, or encounter crashes, incompatibility and other issues during use, feel free to send a private message to the author via the following channels:
